_about: Icons for the enchantments (EnchantmentDefinition, keyed by id), for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set enchantments, painted whole in the skill icons' dark style (UX pass 2026-11-28: the altar showed enchantments as text only). Purified: a carved Nordic sigil lit pale gold and silver-white; Cursed: deep red and violet light with dark smoke; Relic: old green-bronze, worn and ancient. One clear object or sigil each, centred.
